scope: Receipt schema and verification compatibility amendment only; no endpoint, sample order, member, cutoff, model or scoring change
trigger: Source-only follow-up preparation failed before dispatch: newer archive-inspection records use archive_sha256/archive_bytes rather than sha256/bytes. Failed requests-followup-v1 directory remains intact.
normalization: Require every supplied convention to contain both digest and size; reject partial aliases. Validate each pair separately as lowercase SHA256 and positive integer size, excluding booleans, before comparing. If both conventions exist, require exact agreement. Verify actual original archive and dump bytes under approved roots; do not infer availability from receipt access.
legacy_verification: Default strict validation. Only origin-receipt verification opts into compatibility, and only if actual plan.json bytes match the exact frozen origin-plan SHA256 and its decoded object. Regenerate every source, membership and SQL field normally; substitute only that anchored original executing-code inventory and verify its archived copies.
dispatch: New dispatch never receives the legacy-verification allowance and independently checks live executing-code pins. The old plan cannot execute under revised code. New follow-up code and requests use a fresh frozen plan and output directory.
